svg.title: A nurse is assessing factors that could interfere with a client's ability to learn discharge instructions. Which findings should the nurse identify as barriers?
svg.desc: Pain, a mismatch between reading level and materials, environmental noise, and uncorrected sensory deficits all interfere with taking in and storing new information. Asking for a repeat demonstration and naming a personal goal are signs of engagement and motivation, not barriers.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Barriers to Learning
Read the situation
A nurse is assessing factors that could
interfere with a client's ability to learn
discharge instructions. Which findings
should the nurse identify as barriers?
What fits here
The client reports uncontrolled pain · The
client reads at a fourth-grade level and
the handout is written at a college level
· The client's roommate has a loud
television and frequent…
Why it fits
Pain, a mismatch between reading level and
materials, environmental noise, and
uncorrected sensory deficits all interfere
with taking in and storing new
information. Asking for a repeat
demonstration and naming a personal goal
are signs of engagement and motivation,
not barriers.
